A modified raw file would have been caught after the fact by the control lock, not prevented, and this step could not re-hash raw_data/orders.csv because it is outside its inputs.

The five LLM auditor results in this run carry no evidence. gate0_semantic, gate_clean_auditor, gate_metrics_auditor, gate_claims_auditor and gate_release_auditor all read 'driver e2e', and their evidence notes hold no computation. All four worker results report a single self-check 'recomputed independently' with expected and actual 0.473684, a value that is no metric, claim or count in this audit. Their summaries read 'driver e2e', so they carry no evidence of what the workers verified.

Every stage result and carry is stamped 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, three months before analysis_plan.json's registered_at of 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z. The real order of registration and execution cannot be read from these files and has to be taken from audit_runner.py report.

No deterministic rule reads the text of analysis/answers/*.json (only the presence of question and facts), the report's population line, or n on the dashboard cards.
